description: This PHP source file defines the VacancyDao class in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It provides methods for querying, filtering, saving, deleting, and checking vacancies in the system, utilizing Doctrine ORM to interact with the database.

classes.name: VacancyDao
classes.description: Data access object class for managing Vacancy entities in the OrangeHRM recruitment module. Provides CRUD operations and complex querying capabilities for vacancies.

methods.name: getVacancies
methods.description: Retrieves a list of vacancies based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getVacancyListPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a Paginator for vacancy list with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: getVacanciesQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds a Doctrine QueryBuilder with filters for Vacancy entities based on search parameters.

methods.name: saveJobVacancy
methods.description: Persists a Vacancy entity to the database.

methods.name: getVacanciesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of vacancies matching given search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyById
methods.description: Retrieves a Vacancy entity by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingVacancyIds
methods.description: Retrieves existing vacancy IDs from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getHiringManagerEmpNumberList
methods.description: Returns a list of hiring manager employee numbers based on search filters.

methods.name: getVacancyIdList
methods.description: Returns a list of all vacancy IDs.

methods.name: getVacancyIdListForHiringManager
methods.description: Returns vacancy IDs assigned to a specific hiring manager.

methods.name: isHiringManager
methods.description: Checks if a given employee number corresponds to a hiring manager with vacancies.

methods.name: getPublishedVacancyList
methods.description: Returns a list of published vacancies.

methods.name: isActiveJobTitle
methods.description: Verifies if a JobTitle ID refers to an active, non-deleted JobTitle.

methods.name: isActiveHiringManger
methods.description: Checks if an Employee ID belongs to an active hiring manager (with no termination record).
